Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 60-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their first dose of DemoCardolol via oral.
Approximately 3 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Petrov (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter792@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
